policy.area_selection_metric: median emulator steps per level across completed rotations, including heal travel and wipes
policy.promotion_rule: keep the proven fallback until a candidate area completes the same level objective faster without a higher wipe rate

sources.warning: The thread reports Red/Blue data mixed into the map; every candidate must be checked against Pokemon Yellow or the emulator.

bands.label: Boulder
bands.notes: Keep the live deterministic Pewter-to-grass loop; optimize its battle policy before changing location.

bands.label: Cascade
bands.notes: The level gate occurs before Misty and the Cerulean rival, so Route 24/25 cannot be the primary loop even though their grass is fully heatmapped.

bands.label: Rainbow
bands.notes: Reuse the completed-run cave route and measure safe encounter corridors rather than allowing unrestricted cave wandering.

bands.label: Silph Co
bands.notes: Pokemon Tower is not a pre-Silph-Scope grind target. Route 17 has only three heatmapped tiles and is not considered routed; benchmark accessible Route 16 grass.

bands.label: Soul/Marsh

rejected.name: Seafoam Islands
rejected.reason: No tiles from the completed run are present in the cumulative heatmap.

bands.notes: Route 15 is available during the Lavender-to-Fuchsia leg and has extensive completed-run coverage.

bands.label: Volcano/Earth
bands.notes: Already positioned after the Secret Key. Compare floors by completed steps per level and wipe rate.

bands.label: Elite Four
bands.notes: Yellow Victory Road 3F averages over 700 experience per encounter, but its Ground/Rock-heavy table is poor for Electric attacks. Promote it only after an emulator benchmark includes non-Electric move use, healing, and wipes.
